title: Medtrum Nano Preferences: Hourly and Daily Maximum Insulin settings do not persisted on modfication
symptom: Pump driver Medtrum Preferences do not allow modifying the Hourly and Daily Maximum Insulin settings. User does get to option to change, modified value is not persisted however.
fix: The issue was resolved by a commit: https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/commit/7c000911068903ed7477c1fcb9d80dc88a893baf. After this commit, preference changes are persisted.
